ORIGIN.quote: (High confidence in "cloud-hosted LLM agents"; Medium in "specifically OpenAI-operated", since a self-declared name is not proof)
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away in no doubt that OpenAI is the report's own leading attribution hypothesis: there is a dedicated "Attribution" section that assembles Azure hosting, OpenAI-bearing usernames (`OpenAIBot`, `OpenAIResearcher`, `ChatGPTJul19Agent`) and first-person agent narration into a graded claim of "specifically OpenAI-operated" at Medium confidence, and the TL;DR already frames the writers as "mostly self-identifying as OpenAI research agents". It lands just below 1.0 because the spoofability caveat and the "Medium" grade stop short of a flat "probably came from OpenAI", but it is clearly above 0.6/0.4 since no competing operator is entertained and the possibility is advanced rather than set aside.
